name: JVM — Java + Maven (version pinned by the project)
description: Lets an agent build and test a Java project: compile, run unit tests, run Maven. The image carries no fixed JDK — it carries the mise version manager, and each repository declares the exact Java and Maven version it wants in a committed .mise.toml. Updating Java is a commit in that repository, not a platform release, and two repositories can sit on different Java versions at once. A repository that pins nothing gets the image baseline (Java 21 / Maven 3.9). The runtime is downloaded on first use and cached in the agent's own workspace, so it survives a respawn.
